title: Takhta Kebenaran .
intro: Sidroe peunguasa nyang meukuasa, nyang jituri ngon hikmah nyang rayeuk dan takhta nyang meugah, jiteurimong saboh peusan nyang misterius nibak sumber nyang hana jiteupeue. Komunikasi nyang hana teuduga nyoe meutantang keuyakinan dan otoritas awaknyan, geupeuteutap awaknyan lam perjalanan diplomatik nyang akan geu uji akai awaknyan dan akhe jih geupeugot keu kebangkitan rohani nyang mendalam. Jeuët neubuka identitas peundjadjah njoë dan keudjadian-keudjadian njang meu-ubah bandum keuradjeuën awaknjan?
clues: Umat ​​lôn dan ulôn seumah mata uroe, taseutôt cara indatu geutanyoe.
Saboh cicém, saboh hoopoe, nakeuh utusan nyang hana mungkén nyang jiba surat keu ulôn nibak sidroe peumimpin nyang meukuasa.
Keu uji hikmah ureueng nyang kirem, lon kirem hadiah-hadiah nyang meuhareuga, tapi hadiah-hadiah nyan geubalaih, sabab ureueng nyang kirem nyan na hareuta nyang jioh leubeh rayeuk nibak Allah.
Sigohlom ulôn trôh u istana ureuëng njang kirém njan, takhta ulôn njang meugah njan ka dji-angkôt deungon ajaéb keunan dalam siat mata.
Watèë ulôn trôh, ulôn djitanjong peuë keuh takhta njang dji-angkôt njan nakeuh atra ulôn, dan ulôn djaweuëb, 'Lagèë njan keuh tahta njan keuh.'
Lon tamong lam saboh aula rajek deungon lantai njang lon salahkan sibagoë kulam ië, dan dalam watèë njang teukeujot njan, lon peutundok droë ulôn di samping Nabi Sulaiman keu Allah, Tuhan alam-alam.

trial.label: Acara Pusat nyan .
options: Menerima surat dari Nabi Sulaiman SAW .
Peugot kapai mangat seulamat nibak banjir .
trial.answer: Menerima surat dari Nabi Sulaiman SAW .

location.label: Objek Kunci
options: Saboh tungkat nyang meuubah jeuet keu uleue .
Saboh kapai nyang jipeugot nibak papan ngon paku .

outcome.label: Hase Akhe
options: Tundok keu Allah nyang sidroe nyang beutoi (Allah)
Teungoh geu ubah jeut keu tiang sira .
Peudong meunara nyang manyang mangat troh bak Tuhan .
Gadoh hareuta nyang hana meubataih seubagoe hukoman .
outcome.answer: Tundok keu Allah nyang sidroe nyang beutoi (Allah)

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
